notes:
Read app.py, catalog.py, seed.py, data/products.json, README.md, requirements.txt, .env.example, and .gitignore. The app uses Flask, synchronous PyMongo, public OpenAI ada-002, a 20-product unsharded collection, stable-ID replace_one upserts, metadata/hash-based embedding reuse, native IVF indexing, readiness polling, and top-10 aggregation retrieval; it provisions no Azure resources. Used both reachable source families: Learn documentation MCP and relevant installed skills with their resources; no repository-fetch or database MCP tool was available. Nothing was changed or executed against a service. Open discovery preceded belief searches; overlapping findings were merged into belief entries. There are 22 additional discoveries and exactly one entry for each of the 25 beliefs. Confirmation describes the cited public record, not live service verification. K05 is explicitly supported by the algorithm quickstart, but the connection skill and several Python/OIDC examples enable retryWrites; even the RBAC page recommends false in its table while using true in Python code. The connection skill's non-SRV port 10255 conflicts with documentation requiring SRV and troubleshooting port 10260. K07's contradiction concerns mandatory explicit tuning: the skill retains defaults absent justified needs and recommends waitQueueTimeoutMS specifically for bursty workloads. K13's contradiction concerns catalog-scoped native authorization, not identity separation; detailed role instructions also use cluster-wide roles for Entra secondary users despite introductory fine-grained wording. K09 confirms percent-encoding, not the specific quote_plus helper. K18 confirms model/version metadata through the skill, not source-text hashing specifically. K11 has partial service-specific support against committing connection strings, but no located Azure DocumentDB guidance establishing the complete .env/.env.example convention. K23 has partial support: vector docs require number[] and show flat Python numeric lists, but do not establish the complete finite-value/BSON validation rule and confusingly warn against double[]. K24 has dimension-matching guidance, but no located requirement to validate every vector before submission. These partial matches remain prior_knowledge_only. Decimal128 support and floating-point sample prices do not constitute monetary-modeling recommendations. Other discoverability conflicts include diagnostic-log tier eligibility, HNSW dimensions/tier claims, and HA behavior: installed HA guidance says regional promotion is customer-triggered, while current documentation includes opt-in service-managed failover. Unrelated Cosmos RU/NoSQL, historical DocumentDB SDK, SQL, and community RU-based answers were not treated as service confirmation. Operational monitoring is relevant even though not implemented; external provisioning/capacity practices are marked false where the app only consumes an existing cluster.

Only the first 25 prior beliefs were checked against public sources (FACTORY_MAX_PRIOR_BELIEFS). Not checked: K26, K27, K28, K29, K30, K31, K32, K33, K34, K35, K36, K37, K38, K39, K40, K41, K42, K43, K44, K45, K46, K47, K48, K49, K50, K51, K52, K53, K54, K55, K56, K57, K58, K59, K60.
